title: Axon ALPR Activity Report Request (Department of Public Safety)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Arizona Public Records Law, I hereby request the following records:

1. Internal ALPR Activity report in Axon.

The report should include data logged from the period of January 1, 2025, to the date this request is processed. Per Axon's documentation, the Internal ALPR Activity report is available within the LPR > ALPR Search > LPR Audit menu. You can find instructions to locate this here: https://www.axon.com/help/fusus/software/fusus/alpr/alpr-audit.htm

2. Network ALPR Activity report in Axon.

The report should include data logged from the period of January 1, 2025, to the date this request is processed. Per Axon's documentation, the Network ALPR Activity report is available within the LPR > ALPR Search > LPR Audit menu. You can find instructions to locate this here: https://www.axon.com/help/fusus/software/fusus/alpr/alpr-audit.htm

3. ALPR Data Sharing report in Axon.

The report should include data logged from the period of January 1, 2025, to the date this request is processed. Per Axon's documentation, the ALPR Data Sharing report is available within the LPR > ALPR Search > LPR Audit menu. You can find instructions to locate this here: https://www.axon.com/help/fusus/software/fusus/alpr/alpr-audit.htm

4. ALPR Hotlist Management Audit report in Axon.

The report should include data logged from the period of January 1, 2025, to the date this request is processed. Per Axon's documentation, the ALPR Hotlist Management Audit report is available within the LPR > ALPR Search > LPR Audit menu. You can find instructions to locate this here: https://www.axon.com/help/fusus/software/fusus/alpr/alpr-audit.htm

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Jesse Domino

title: Wind Farm development/ Air Force missile fields

communications.subject: Montana Freedom of Information Act Request: Wind Farm development/ Air Force missile fields
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Montana Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Attn Ben Brouwer, Energy Bureau Chief

1. A map of the area in Montana that is off-limits to wind farms due to Air Force restrictions on wind turbine development within 2 nautical miles of intercontinental ballistic missile silos overseen by Malmstrom Air Force Vase. Or, if not that, the inverse – a map of the state where wind farms are allowed (a map that would presumably show a large exclusion area over the panhandle where silos are located).

2. Any records on how many proposed wind farms (such as the Grizzly Wind farm)  were impacted by the Air Force's 2 nautical mile restriction on airspace around missile silos, including any records detailing their expected power generation and how many turbines they would have included.

3. Any studies or records on the expected socioeconomic impact of those wind farms (such as Grizzly Wind) would have had on communities in the area.

4. Any records on average, market-rate leasing fees that landowners receive when leasing land for turbines.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Taylor Barnes

communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: El Salvador State Dept Lobbying
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

All 2026 meeting notes, text messages, emails, and documents concerning State Department officials and Damian Merlo, an employee of the Office of the President of El Salvador who is a FARA-registered agent for President Nayib Bukele. Merlo also runs Latin American Advisory Group LLC and acts as a registered agent for the government of Grenada. A recent FARA registration, which outlines his many contacts with the State Department, can be found here: https://efile.fara.gov/docs/6898-Supplemental-Statement-20260730-13.pdf

That filing mentions meetings or communications with State Department officials Gavin Wax, Amb. Christopher Landau, Viviana Bovo, and Caleb Orr. Please also search for notes and communications relating to the 1/13/26 meeting between these officials and Damian Merlo.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Jacob Silverman
